title: The Complete Advancement Multiplier
description: Every advancement you earn doubles your drop multiplier. Get enough and you're pulling over 2 billion drops per block.
body:
# The Complete Advancement Multiplier

Every advancement you earn permanently doubles your drop multiplier. Start with 1x. Get 10 advancements and you're at 1,024x. Get 31 and you hit the integer limit - 2,147,483,647x. A bossbar tracks your current multiplier at all times.

## Features
- **Every advancement doubles** your drop multiplier - permanently
- **Tracks all vanilla advancements** across every category automatically
- **Bossbar** shows your current multiplier at all times
- **Per-player tracking** - each player has their own multiplier
- Works in survival, no cheats required

## Scaling
| Advancements Earned | Drop Multiplier |
|---|---|
| 0 | 1x |
| 1 | 2x |
| 2 | 4x |
| 3 | 8x |
| 5 | 32x |
| 10 | 1,024x |
| 20 | 1,048,576x |
| 31+ | 2,147,483,647x (max) |

## How to use
1. Install the datapack
2. Load your world
3. Earn advancements - your multiplier updates instantly
4. If adding to an existing world, run `/function adv_multiplier:recalculate` as each player to sync

## Notes
- Compatible with Minecraft 26.1.2
- Pure datapack - no mods, no executables

If you make a video using this datapack, a credit or link back to this page would be appreciated!
